पिडकः --का A small boil,
pimple, pustule.

पीड् {c10c} U. (पीडयति-ते, पीडित)
1
To pain, torment, harm, hurt,
injure, harass, annoy, molest; नीलं
च पीपिडच्छरैः

; 7. 29.
--2
To oppose, resist.
--3 To besiege
(as a city).
--4 To press or squeeze
together, compress, pinch; कंठे
पीडयन्

.
--6 To neglect.
--7 To cover with anything
inauspicious.
--8 To eclipse.
--9 To
overpower.
--10 To break, violate.
--11
To take away, remove.
--12 To stir,
agitate.
--13 To cover, wrap.

पीडनं [पीड् भावे ल्युट्]
1 Paining,
distressing, oppressing, inflicting
pain;

.
--3 An
instrument for pressing.
--4 Taking,
holding, seizing; as in करपीडन or
पाणिपीडन q. v.
--5 Laying waste,
devastation.
--6 Threshing corn.
--7 An eclipse; as in ग्रहपीडन q. v.
--8 Suppressing sounds, a fault in
the pronunciation of vowels.

पीडा [पीड् --भावे भिदा˚ अङ्]
1 Pain,
trouble, suffering, annoyance,
molestation, agony; आश्रमपीडा

.
--3
Devastation, laying waste.
--4
Violation, infringement.
--5 Restriction.
--6 Pity, compassion.
--7 Eclipse.
--8 A chaplet, garland for the head.
--9 The Sarala tree.
--10 A basket,
--Comp.
--कर a. troublesome,
painful.
--करणं torturing.

पीडित p. p. [पीड्-क्त]
1 Pained,
harassed, tormented, oppressed,
pinched.
--2 Squeezed, pressed,

.
--4 Violated, broken.
--5
Laid waste, devastated.
--6
Eclipsed.
--7 Bound, tied
--तं
1
Paining, injuring, harassing.
--2 A
particular mode of sexual
enjoyment.
--तं ind. Fast, closely,
firmly.
